en.role: Developer in Stockholm · builds and runs self-hosted software
en.summary: Developer who learns by building. I studied **Information and Communications Technology** at KTH, and I design, ship and run my own software end to end: a **media server that friends and family use every day**, low-level **Linux and Vulkan tooling** for gaming, and the tools behind a three-machine home network. At home anywhere from C and Rust to Node.js web apps and Windows server operations.
